Hey folks, I recently made a commitment to myself, my fiancé, and in my faith.

Our church minister asked us to hold off on joining until after we were married because we live together and have had intercourse before marriage. We agreed and decided to stop having intercourse to prove our commitment to Christ and to ourselves in our faith. The minister doesn’t know this, but we’ve done it together as a couple as an exercise of faith.

In addition to this, we both agreed to stop masturbating and both agreed to stop smoking weed. Which had slowly become a daily routine in the past 9 months or so, instead of an occasional treat.

For context, we weren’t very sex-driven anyway, it would be sporadic and sometimes only happen two to three times a month anyway, but personally masturbating was pretty consistent, essentially a routine where I would do it on the same two occasions sometimes three occasions a week.

We’ve now not had sex in probably 90ish days (roughly first half of July), not masturbated since 7th September (35 days) and not smoked weed since 16th September (26 days).

I’m pleased with my progress, however, I thought that this would “completely rewire” my brain. And that I would be more motivated, more productive, more attentive, more focused and just on the whole feeling better.

But instead, I just feel on the whole a bit worse than I did before. I feel quite emotionally and motivationally drained.

I woke up with morning glory for the first few days, but now I’ve not had an erection in days.

I thought that giving these things up would help, but right now it feels more like a loss than a gain.

And I can’t keep my mind off of sexual and lustful things, it’s like my brain is infected or something.

The weed addiction I feel hasn’t given me any positive or negative, but instead I just feel there is more of a void.

Our wedding isn’t until for another 375 days roughly, and we will obviously have intercourse on our wedding night that we are both excited for.

But I need motivation and words to keep me motivated. To help my stay disciplined. Either scripturally or just from your own experience.

How can I resist temptation?

When will it start to pay off? Will it start to feel good at any point?

When will it feel like a gain instead of a loss?

Will my intrusive sexual thoughts go away?

How have you managed to move past this first phase and move into the lasting phase of prolonged abstinence?
